errors.text: The proposed FCC+B2 constitution is inconsistent with the requirement to avoid intermetallic formation because B2 is an ordered intermetallic phase, not an ordinary disordered solid solution.

The cited evidence does not establish that annealing at 900 °C for 3 minutes after severe plastic deformation preserves grains below 50 nm; rapid recovery, recrystallization, and grain growth are credible competing outcomes.

The falsification experiment does not distinguish the proposed grain-boundary and transformation-based mechanism from simple interstitial solid-solution strengthening because it lacks grain-size-matched and phase-fraction-matched controls.
